text:
Type: storage coffee table with drawers
Use: holding drinks and storing items in front of a sofa; living room
Style: industrial, modern, rustic
Materials: oak wood with a dark finish, brushed nickel metal base and pulls
Colors: dark warm brown wood, silver grey metal
Shape: boxy rectangular body with two front drawers and long bar pulls, raised on an open metal sled frame, chunky top, medium-wide and solid
Feel: sturdy, warm, refined
Goes with: leather or grey sofas, steel accents, neutral walls; industrial or modern living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Glenwood Storage Coffee Table, 46"W, Oak
product.description: This handsome coffee table has the additional benefit of allowing you to clean up quickly for company. Stash remote controls, magazines and toys in the two drawers and storage compartment, then close the top to make way for snack and beverage trays. 46"W x 30"D x 17"H Hardwood with quarter-sawn oak veneer for a handsome grain; metal drawer pulls Simple, sleek design and classic oak veneer combine for a transitional style Easy gliding, self-closing drawers; back of table has lift top and storage area Wipe with soft dry cloth Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
